evidence: Built omission_fixture.py, an adversarial fixture attacking three real components with manifests that omit a real file, plus residual_coverage.py to close the gaps it found. 16 declared scenarios, 12 expecting non-zero exit, all behaved exactly as declared: PO03_OMISSION_PASS scenarios=16 rejecting=12 controls=2 generation_gaps=2. Verification fails closed on every omitting manifest, including the hardest case where the manifest is fully self-consistent (entry dropped, artifact_count decremented, its bytes subtracted from total_bytes): coverage_assert.py refused with UNCOVERED_FILE and manifest_tool.py verify refused a text manifest whose TOTAL trailer was rewritten to match the surviving entries. Weaker forms were refused by distinct checks: COUNT_DISAGREEMENT, TOTAL_BYTES_DISAGREEMENT, NO_ARTIFACTS. Two controls passed, so the refusals are not a verifier that refuses everything. Two omissions escape by never reaching a verifier and both are reproduced, not asserted: (1) the live emit_result.py selects artifacts by basename at any depth, so a real payload committed at slot/nested/manifest.json is never counted and the emitter exits 0 over it - five real files committed, three covered, two omitted - though coverage_assert.py then refuses that commit with UNCOVERED_FILE x2, so verification itself still fails closed; (2) a file committed to a slot after the artifact commit is invisible to per-manifest auditing because the manifest stays faithful to the commit it names. residual_coverage.py catches both, and against this repository at d5417ec reports PO03_RESIDUAL_PASS slots=7 files_accounted_for=40 with 0 residual bytes across every manifested slot. python3 -I -m unittest discover on this subtree: Ran 24 tests OK. Testing found and fixed a fail-open in residual_coverage.py where an explicitly named nonexistent slot reported a clean pass; it now exits 2.
falsifiable_hypothesis: A manifest that omits a real file must fail verification rather than report success.
limitations: Coverage is only ever relative to a stated frame; this unit adds a second frame (the slot at a commit) rather than removing the need to choose one, and a file outside any attempts slot is invisible to it by construction. The emitter is unchanged because workstreams/po03/tools/** is immutable to this producer, so its basename omission is compensated downstream, not fixed at source, and any consumer that reads an emitted manifest without a residual check stays exposed. Matching relocated files by content hash suppresses rename false positives but also means bytes duplicated from an already-manifested entry under a new name are not reported. The emitter needs a task capsule and control/** is immutable, so the fixture feeds the real tool a synthetic capsule inside a scratch repository. Scratch repositories are not durable evidence; only the captured output committed here is. Only two verifiers and one generator were attacked.
